Title: Microsoft Cognitive Services | Custom Vision Service API

Body.Content:
Custom Vision Service API aims to identify trained objects and show their location within images. Export your models and convert them to the ONNX format, which can be used natively in Windows 10 apps, or export them to containers that can be deployed in Azure web services such as Azure Functions, IoT Edge, or Machine Learning.

Learn More
